title: Quaint caps of squares and cubes
html_source:
numbers squared or cubed are noted with a exponent 2 or 3 set the to right and above the base number so they look like caps

PROPOSED SUGGESTION: Possibly a reference to the Arabic origin of our mathmatics system, squares and cubes would be difficult in Roman numerals.
